jobs.title: Manager Data Analytics
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
The  Manager, Data Analytics  plays a critical role within Mattel’s DTC Consumer Data & Analytics team, helping unlock the value of consumer and ecommerce data to drive business growth. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, technology, and business strategy—partnering with stakeholders across ecommerce, digital marketing, product, merchandising, and technology to transform data into actionable insights.
As a leader on the analytics team, you will drive complex analytical initiatives, guide measurement strategy, and develop scalable reporting and analytical solutions that help the organization understand consumer behavior, optimize performance, and identify opportunities for growth. You will also mentor analysts on the team, establish best practices in analytics and experimentation, and help shape the evolving analytics strategy supporting Mattel’s global DTC ecosystem.
The ideal candidate is both technically strong and business-oriented, with a passion for solving complex problems, mentoring others, and translating data into meaningful business impact.
What Your Impact Will Be:
Advanced Analytics & Modeling
- Design and execute complex analyses using statistical and computational methods to evaluate ecommerce performance, consumer behavior, and marketing effectiveness
- Apply advanced statistical techniques such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and experimental design to evaluate business initiatives and product changes
- Develop predictive and descriptive models to estimate outcomes such as consumer lifetime value, purchase propensity, churn risk, and campaign performance
- Prototype and evaluate advanced analytical approaches, including machine learning methods and domain-specific models where appropriate

Data Engineering & Data Architecture Collaboration
- Write highly optimized SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale datasets across multiple relational databases and cloud data platforms
- Partner closely with data engineering teams to design and improve scalable data pipelines, data models, and data structures that support analytics and reporting needs
- Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across DTC data sources including ecommerce platforms, digital analytics, CRM, marketing systems, and operational data
- Contribute to improvements in data architecture, analytics workflows, and data governance practices that enable reliable and scalable analysis

Data Visualization & Analytics Products
- Design and build scalable dashboards and reporting solutions that enable stakeholders to monitor key DTC performance metrics and identify opportunities for growth
- Develop interactive visualizations and data products that communicate complex analytical results clearly and effectively
- Establish visualization standards and best practices that ensure clarity, consistency, and actionable storytelling across analytics outputs
- Deliver insights through compelling data storytelling that supports executive decision-making

Measurement, Experimentation & Performance Analysis
- Define measurement frameworks and key performance indicators for ecommerce initiatives, digital marketing campaigns, and consumer engagement programs
- Lead experimentation initiatives, including A/B testing and experimental design, to evaluate product features, merchandising strategies, and marketing initiatives
- Analyze and interpret experimental results to provide clear recommendations and guide product and business strategy
- Develop standardized approaches for measuring funnel performance, customer journeys, and consumer lifecycle behavior

Analytics Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
- Lead high-impact analytics projects that support Mattel’s Direct-to-Consumer ecommerce strategy and digital transformation
- Translate complex business questions into structured analytical approaches and technical solutions
- Mentor analysts on advanced analytical methods, coding standards, and best practices in analytics development
- Partner with product, marketing, merchandising, and technology teams to embed data-driven decision-making across the organization
What We’re Looking For:
Experience & Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline (Master’s degree preferred)
- 8+ years of experience  in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field
- Experience leading complex analytics projects and influencing business decisions through data
- Prior experience in ecommerce, digital analytics, consumer analytics, or retail environments strongly preferred

Technical Skills
- Advanced proficiency in  SQL  and working with large-scale relational datasets
- Experience working with cloud data platforms such as  Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, or Athena
- Strong proficiency with  Python or R  for statistical analysis, data processing, and modeling
- Experience with  data visualization and BI tools  such as Tableau, QuickSight, Looker, or similar platforms
- Strong understanding of  statistical analysis and experimentation , including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and A/B testing
- Familiarity with  digital analytics platforms  such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics

Business & Analytical Skills
- Strong understanding of ecommerce and marketing performance metrics such as: - Conversion rate
- Customer acquisition
- Demand and net sales
- Contribution margin
- Customer lifetime value
- Retention and engagement metrics

- Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations that influence business strategy
- Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems into actionable analytical approaches

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
Mattel is seeking an Associate Manager or Manager, Supply Chain Governance, Risk Management & Compliance, Mattel Ventures, to serve as the Singapore based regional compliance partner for Mattel Ventures supplier, factory, licensee, and business partner activity.
This hands on individual contributor role will partner closely with Mattel Ventures leaders and regional teams to support early due diligence, supplier onboarding, audit readiness, compliance monitoring, responsible sourcing initiatives, and risk based decision support in a fast moving innovation environment.
The successful candidate will operate with a venture mindset: structure ambiguity quickly, build fit for purpose compliance pathways, use data to identify risk, and enable speed to market while upholding Mattel standards for responsible sourcing, regulatory compliance, human rights, EHS, labor practices, and supply chain integrity.
What Your Impact Will Be:
- Serve as the regional GRC partner for Mattel Ventures, embedding supply chain compliance due diligence into concept development, sourcing, supplier onboarding, production planning, launch readiness, and post launch monitoring.
- Lead compliance support for third party manufacturers, licensee factories, suppliers, vendors, and business partners in assigned regions, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, Mattel standards, and applicable industry or customer codes.
- Collect supplier compliance data, review and analyze audit reports and supporting documentation, and coordinate Mattel initiated third party audits when needed.
- Assess compliance risk for new supplier models, emerging materials, new geographies, licensing activity, and venture partnerships, translating findings into clear mitigation plans and timely escalation.
- Analyze cross business unit compliance performance, identify trends, and provide data driven recommendations that help leadership understand risk, readiness, and improvement priorities.
- Serve as a compliance consultant to Mattel Ventures and functional partners, including Global Brand Team, Ecommerce, Contract Manufacturing, Consumer Products, Sustainability, Global Supply Chain, Quality, Legal, and regional commercial teams.
- Communicate compliance standards, expectations, and requirements to factories, licensees, suppliers, business units, and functional teams, ensuring timely closure of gaps and practical alignment with business needs.
- Partner with data teams to interpret compliance information, organize reporting, analyze results, identify trends, and create ongoing status updates for management and stakeholders.
- Support Responsible Sourcing and human rights initiatives, including source traceability, supply chain mapping, human rights assessments, social compliance reviews, and related improvement actions.
- Manage relationships with third party firms engaged for compliance audits, responsible sourcing initiatives, or other GRC related projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and follow through.
- Engage and educate factories, licensees, and business partners to strengthen self monitoring, preventive controls, corrective action discipline, and sustained compliance ownership.
- Lead or support priority projects assigned by management, especially where Mattel Ventures requires rapid compliance assessment, risk mitigation, or new operating mechanisms to support speed to market.

- Experienced supply chain compliance professional with strong judgment, business partnership skills, and the ability to balance innovation speed with responsible sourcing and compliance discipline.

- Ability to influence cross functional teams, suppliers, factories, licensees, and external partners without direct authority across a regional and global operating model.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of employees, leadership, suppliers, and external partners.
- Strong organizational, follow up, research, and project management skills, with the discipline to manage multiple priorities and close actions in a timely manner.
- High integrity, cultural sensitivity, resilience, and accountability, with a collaborative style and a clear commitment to protecting Mattel standards and reputation.

Experience, Education, and Skills:
- University degree preferred in supply chain, business, sustainability, compliance, EHS, engineering, social sciences, or a related discipline.
- 5 plus years of progressive experience in supply chain compliance, responsible sourcing, human rights, manufacturing compliance, audit management, risk management, or a related field, preferably with a multinational manufacturing or consumer products company.
- Knowledge or experience in Quality Management Systems, EHS Management Systems, risk management, corrective action management, supplier due diligence, and third party audit programs is preferred.

• Review complex cases and recommend appropriate disciplinary, corrective, or preventive actions.

• Provide guidance to managers and supervisors on disciplinary procedures, grievance handling, and Industrial Relations practices.

• Ensure proper documentation, confidentiality, and record-keeping for all Industrial Relations matters.

• Advise management, managers, and supervisors on employee conduct, grievances, attendance, performance concerns, workplace conflicts, and related employee matters.

• Oversee employee grievances, workplace investigations, counselling, corrective actions, and case resolution.

• Ensure Employee Relations matters are handled fairly, consistently, confidentially, and in accordance with Company policies and applicable employment legislation.

• Monitor employee concerns, workplace trends, and recurring issues and recommend appropriate improvement or preventive actions.

• Promote open communication and positive working relationships between employees and management.

• Support business leaders in strengthening employee engagement, workplace culture, trust, and overall employee experience.

• Provide guidance on the interpretation and consistent application of Company policies and employee-related procedures.

• Maintain effective relationships with relevant government authorities, legal advisers, employee representatives, and other stakeholders.

• Monitor and report key Employee Relations indicators and ensure proper documentation and confidentiality of employee-related cases.

• Develop and implement the annual Internship and MGIP recruitment strategy, including intake planning, target disciplines, headcount requirements, timelines, and departmental placements.

• Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with universities, colleges, and higher learning institutions to strengthen the Company’s early-career talent pipeline.

• Oversee campus engagement activities, career fairs, university collaborations, recruitment campaigns, and employer-branding initiatives to strengthen the Company’s visibility and attract high-potential students and graduates.

• Oversee the end-to-end recruitment and selection process for interns and MGIP participants, including sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, offers, placement, and onboarding.

• Monitor participant performance, development, engagement, and overall program experience in collaboration with department managers and assigned supervisors or mentors.

• Establish a structured performance evaluation and feedback process to assess participants’ capabilities, potential, and suitability for future employment opportunities.

• Ensure Internship and MGIP administration, documentation, allowances, agreements, records, and related processes comply with Company policies, statutory requirements, budget controls, and audit standards.

• Advise MDT management on workforce planning, recruitment, employee relations, industrial relations, policies, and workplace matters.

appropriate actions.
